title: Bleach Announces Special Livestream Ahead of Anime Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is going all out for the anime’s grand finale as it has announced it will be hosting a special livestream to help usher in the final episode’s premiere.

title: A-DO Manga to End on November 18
content: The November issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that Jaku Amano 's A-DO manga will end in its next chapter in the magazine's next issue on November 18. The series entered a hiatus in October due to the author's poor physical health, but resumed on February 19.
author: ANN

title: Firefly Wedding's Oreko Tachibana Launches New Manga in Winter
content: The 13th and final compiled book volume of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding ( Hotaru no Yomeiri ) manga announced on Monday that Tachibana will launch a new manga in Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app this coming winter.
author: ANN

title: Orient's Shinobu Ohtaka Launches New Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app announced on Tuesday that manga creator Shinobu Ohtaka will launch a new manga titled Geek and Crown ( Geekrown ) on October 27.
author: ANN

title: Go! Go! Loser Ranger! Manga Goes on Hiatus Again Due to Creator's Health
content: This year's 47th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Wednesday that Negi Haruba 's Go, Go, Loser Ranger! ( Sentai Daishikkaku ) manga is going on hiatus due to Haruba's health. The announcement did not reveal when the manga will resume.
author: ANN

title: Eleceed TV Anime's English-Subtitled Trailer Reveals April 2027 Delay
content: The official website for the television anime of author Jeho Son and artist ZHENA 's webtoon series ELECEED started streaming the anime's English-subtitled trailer, and announced its April 2027 premiere on Wednesday. Amuse Creative Studio had originally announced a 2026 premiere for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Grotesqqque Anime Film Previews Song by Junna, yutori's Kotoko Satō
content: The official website for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) confirmed on Wednesday that the film will feature the song "ZUKIZUKI" as performed by JUNNA and the yutori rock band's vocalist Kotoko Satō , two music contributors for the "Yoroshiku★Girl" short story.
author: ANN
